Q: Github action error with Set up QEMU - Error: Unable to locate executable file: docker A:

The docker command is not available on egahmad/php7.3-laravel-apache-development, and I don't believe the qemu steps are designed to run within a container (they're making changes to the kernel). To run the qemu steps on the ubuntu-latest host, I believe you'd need to remove the container section. If steps require this environment, you can try breaking up the job into multiple jobs, with some steps running in the container, and others running directly on the host.

If you're going through all these steps in Github Actions because your docker build needs the binaries already created, I'd recommend migrating to a multi-stage build. The first stage would be your egahmad/php7.3-laravel-apache-development image, running the steps you currently perform in GHA, and then the second stage would copy from that first stage rather than the build context.

Q: Error SEC7120: [CORS] The origin 'http://localhost:4200' did not find 'http://localhost:4200' in the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response A:

Open the file App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs. Add config.EnableCors(); in WebApiConfig.Register method.

Q: how to automatically install Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015 used in a java code A:

If you already have bat file for install best way to do this will be to include install of vc_redist in this *.bat before install. From what I know it is not posiible to include this in the *.jar. Better will be to pack all files into zip (together with this *.bat script).

To install vcredist in bat silently you will have to add these commands:

@echo OFF
reg Query "HKLM\Hardware\Description\System\CentralProcessor\0" | find /i "x86" > NUL && set OS=32BIT || set OS=64BIT

if %OS%==32BIT runas /user:Administrator %~dp0\vcredist_x86.exe /q /norestart
if %OS%==64BIT runas /user:Administrator %~dp0\vcredist_x64.exe /q /norestart

#rest of your script

Checking if system is 32bit of 64bit is taken from here (batch file to check 64bit or 32bit OS)

%~dp0 resolves to the full path of the folder in which the batch script resides.

Edit:

As the runas might not be the best solution to problem of running this as administrator I will direct you to these posts to read about running with administrator privilages in bat

How to code a BAT file to always run as admin mode?

How can I auto-elevate my batch file, so that it requests from UAC administrator rights if required?

Q: How to separate two environments for testing? A:

The issue is two things:

  1. Both stages should dependsOn: Build independently (parallel, not sequential)
  2. Manual vs Auto is handled via Azure DevOps Environments + Approval Gates — not a YAML keyword

Correct YAML structure

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - job: BuildJob
    steps:
    - script: echo "Building..."

- stage: Deploy_DEV
  dependsOn: Build
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployDEV
    environment: 'DEV'
    variables:
      ENV: DEV
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - script: echo "Deploying to DEV"

- stage: Deploy_UAT
  dependsOn: Build
  condition: succeeded('Build')
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployUAT
    environment: 'UAT'
    variables:
      ENV: UAT
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - script: echo "Deploying to UAT"

To add manual approval for DEV, go to Pipelines → Environments → DEV → Approvals and checks → Add Approval in the Azure DevOps portal. The pipeline will pause at DEV until someone approves, while UAT auto-triggers on successful build.

If using templates, reference them at the jobs level inside a stage, not at stages level:

- stage: Deploy_DEV
  dependsOn: Build
  jobs:
  - template: ./deploy-jobs.yml
    parameters:
      ENV: DEV

Q: How to get memory size of variable? A:

You can use the way the package math uses:

intSize := 32 << (^uint(0) >> 63)

This will set intSize to the the size of an int, in bits (to get in bytes, divide by 8).

Explanation:

  • ^uint(0) is the maximum value of an uint (since ^ inverts bits).
  • ... >> 63 moves every bits right by 63 places. If uint is 64 bits, only one bit is still here: this give 1. Else, nothing remain: this give 0.
  • 32 << ... moves every bits of 32 left by the previous result. If it is 0, 32 remains in place, else, it becomes 64.

The advantage of this solution is that it do not use any dependency: you can run this anywhere.

Q: Multiple values from CASE WHEN...THEN expression A:

CASE will only return a single value. You must rewrite your query. Something like this:

SELECT * 
FROM impl_debitor_information i, impl_shop where shop_id s
WHERE d.soft_delete='F' 
AND d.shop_id ='4987bc1b-c0a8-6cb7-12f4-0243011f7099' 
AND d.shop_id = s.shop_id
AND (d.debitor_type IS NULL 
     OR (d.debitor_type IN ('T','D') AND s.techfund_debitor_enabled = 'YES')
     OR (d.debitor_type IN ('D') AND s.techfund_debitor_enabled <> 'YES'))
